The safety gate kernel then applies a sequential validation protocol across four critical subsystems (db:generate, typecheck, tests, build), each producing binary outcomes that inform a cumulative Bayesian belief. The integrity assessment function aggregates these outcomes into a single scalar measure, enabling GSE to reason about additive value versus regression risk. Failure modes include SHA mismatches, gate failures, or integrity degradation, which trigger retroactive re-evaluation of the entire chain.
